dict.string: Toggle frontmost window between maximized and restored size.

target_bundle_id="${focusedapp:-${target_app:-}}" if [ -z "$target_bundle_id" ]; then target_bundle_id=$(/usr/bin/osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get bundle identifier of first application process whose frontmost is true' 2>/dev/null) fi if [ -z "$target_bundle_id" ]; then exit 0 fi /usr/bin/osascript - "$target_bundle_id" <<'APPLESCRIPT' on run argv if (count of argv) = 0 then return set targetBundleID to item 1 of argv if targetBundleID is "com.runningwithcrayons.Alfred" or targetBundleID is "com.runningwithcrayons.Alfred-Preferences" then return
tell application "System Events" try try set targetProcess to first application process whose bundle identifier is targetBundleID on error set targetProcess to first application process whose name is targetBundleID end try if (count of windows of targetProcess) is greater than 0 then try perform action "AXZoom" of window 1 of targetProcess on error try click (first button of window 1 of targetProcess whose description is "zoom button") end try end try end if end try end tell end run APPLESCRIPT
